lines: GTA 6's morality scale tops out at Irredeemable

beats.say: PC Gamer says you can be Professional or Irredeemable.
Your choices define what kind of criminal you are.
It's set in Leonida, a fictional version of Florida.
You play as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
The map includes Vice City, Grassrivers, and the Leonida Keys.
The Criminal Profile system lets you choose your path.
GTA 6's morality scale tops out at Irredeemable, PC Gamer reports.

meta.title: GTA 6's morality scale tops out at Irredeemable
meta.alt_title: GTA 6's Criminal Profile: Professional or Irredeemable
meta.summary: GTA 6's morality scale tops out at Irredeemable, letting players choose their criminal path. The game launches on 19 November 2026.
meta.comment: What kind of criminal will you be in GTA 6?
sources: GTA 6's souped-up Red Dead Redemption 2-style morality system will scale from 'Professional' to 'Irredeemable' so players can decide what kind of criminal they want to be
Dog poo, anti-social behaviour, and Jason: Our latest look at GTA 6 gameplay comes from an episode of South Park
facts: Grand Theft Auto VI is scheduled to be released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
Grand Theft Auto VI is set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida.
The story follows a criminal couple: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
The map includes Vice City, Grassrivers, and the Leonida Keys.
PC Gamer reports Grand Theft Auto VI's morality scale tops out at Irredeemable.

es.title: La moral de GTA 6 llega a Irredimible 🎮
es.summary: La escala de moralidad de GTA 6 llega al nivel de Irredimible, permitiendo a los jugadores elegir su camino criminal. El juego se lanza el 19 de noviembre de 2026.

hi.title: GTA 6 की नैतिकता का स्तर अपवित्र है 🎮
hi.summary: GTA 6 की नैतिकता का पैमाना इर्रीडिमेबल तक पहुंचता है, जिससे खिलाड़ियों को अपना आपराधिक रास्ता चुनने की अनुमति मिलती है। यह गेम 19 नवंबर 2026 को लॉन्च होगा।
